purpose: Preserve all four user reference layouts and two additional deformable cases.
source_policy: All six outputs use original Drive PDFs, with native vectors and image pixels preserved.
content_edits: None. Original labels, explanatory notes, curves, final CD values, and success markers are retained.

deformable_provenance.predictor: Third consolidation pass, slow-only cl_noada_r3; main quantitative table uses the fourth pass.
deformable_provenance.selection: Cases selected from the repeated 50-instance stream where both baselines fail and ours succeeds; not held-out test instances.
deformable_provenance.dino_wm_frames: Recorded actions replayed in the original FleX simulator.
deformable_provenance.final_cd: Values recorded by original runtime evaluation, not remeasured from replay.

rigid_provenance.square: Frozen trajectory is action replay; AdaJEPA and Ours are simulator frames saved during execution.
rigid_provenance.redagent: All displayed trajectories are action replay in the original simulator.
rigid_provenance.prediction_losses: Each method is scored with its own model weights. Absolute loss levels are not directly comparable across methods.

figures.reference_difference: The archived native PDF correctly labels the displayed trajectories as Replay; the user screenshot has Simulator labels and truncates the lower explanation. The native Replay labels and full explanation are preserved.
